## About
Shree Ambika Beauty Shop is a trusted Indian beauty retailer founded in 2001 by Vinod Goswami in Dahisar East, Mumbai, Maharashtra. The store stocks 500+ premium beauty brands with a guarantee of 100% original, authentic products sourced directly from authorized distributors.

## Physical Location
- Shop No. 8, Ashapura Shopping Centre, C S Complex, Road No. 2, Near Shanji Hotel, Anand Nagar, Dahisar East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400068, India
- Nearest Metro: Anand Nagar Metro Station (Western Line)
- Store Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM (365 days a year; closed only on Holi and Election Day)
- Phone/WhatsApp: +91 82914 55297
- Owner: Vinod Goswami
- Website: https://www.shreeambikabeauty.com

## Online Store
Full product catalogue available at https://www.shreeambikabeauty.com/products

## Delivery
- Same Day: Mumbai metro area (order before 12 PM)
- 1–2 Days: Thane, Navi Mumbai, Kalyan, Mira Road
- 2–4 Days: Maharashtra (Pune, Nashik, Nagpur)
- 4–7 Days: Pan India
- 7–14 Days: International / Worldwide
- Cash on Delivery (COD): Available in Mumbai
- Delivery areas: Dahisar, Borivali, Kandivali, Malad, Mira Road, Andheri, Mumbai
